_what: Phase A's published numbers, so that a re-run can be CHECKED against them rather than merely produced.  Read by MDA_partition_experiment.py --verify.  A disagreement is a FINDING to surface, not an error to swallow.
_source: arch_surgery/docs/reports/MDA_partition_exp_results.md, tables 4.4.2 and 4.5, re-derived by A26 (method-fixes) from A18's recorded artifacts and confirmed identical under the A26 predicate at three scale floors.
_units: in-loop model evaluations summed over each deck's design points, at tau = 1e-6, hoist off; three decks from 2026-09-02 (D17 drops large_tokamak_eval).
_matched_accuracy_note: A1 / A0 at each deck's own calibration point, read off the lower envelope cost(a) = min{cost_i : accuracy_i <= a}.  Compared to a relative tolerance rather than exactly, because it is an interpolated ratio of counts.
